claim: Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion.
summary: As of my knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, Meta's 2026 capital expenditure guidance was not established in my knowledge, so the claimed $130 billion to $145 billion range cannot be verified.

sub_claims.text: Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures to be at least $130 billion.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Meta's 2026 capex guidance would be established; no basis in my knowledge to confirm a $130B lower bound.

sub_claims.text: Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures to be at most $145 billion.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Meta's 2026 capex guidance would be established; no basis in my knowledge to confirm a $145B upper bound.
